title: ChoreoStudio: Planning What, When, and Who in Music-Driven Group Choreography
abstract: arXiv:2610.32325v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Music-driven group dance generation must decide not only how each dancer moves, but also what formation the group should form, when it should change, and who should execute each transition. Existing methods can generate orderly and rhythmically synchronized group motion, but remain limited in formation evolution and inter-dancer interaction. In human choreography, formation transitions often align with changes in high-level musical structure, such as the progression from an introduction to a chorus or from a chorus to a climax. We present ChoreoStudio, which makes choreography planning explicit. A music disentangler first decomposes the audio into frame-level rhythmic features and segment-level structural features. Given the segment-level features and sparse labels, a frozen omni-modal model acts as a scriptwriter, producing a global semantic description that guides the Director's choreography planning. translated_title: ChoreoStudio：音乐驱动群舞编舞中的“做什么、何时做、谁来做”规划
translated_abstract: 音乐驱动的群舞生成不仅要决定每位舞者如何移动，还要决定群体应形成什么样的队形、何时改变队形，以及由谁来执行每一次队形转换。现有方法能够生成有序且节奏同步的群体动作，但在队形演化和舞者间交互方面仍然受限。在人类编舞中，队形转换通常与高层音乐结构的变化相吻合，例如从前奏进入副歌，或从副歌进入高潮段落。我们提出了ChoreoStudio，它使编舞规划显式化。音乐解耦器首先将音频分解为帧级节奏特征和段级结构特征。在给定段级特征和稀疏标签的条件下，一个冻结的全模态模型充当“编剧”角色，生成全局语义描述，用于指导“导演”的编舞规划。基于这一上下文，导演……
tldr: ChoreoStudio通过将音乐解耦为节奏与结构特征，并让全模态模型扮演编剧和导演进行显式编舞规划，从而自动决定音乐驱动群舞中队形变化的内容、时机与执行者。
en_tdlr: ChoreoStudio makes choreography planning explicit by disentangling music into rhythmic and structural features and employing an omni-modal model as scriptwriter and director, enabling it to decide what formation changes occur, when they occur, and who executes them in music-driven group dance.
